name: @w6w-apps/elastic
description: Search, index, and manage documents and indices on any Elasticsearch cluster.

w6w.longDescription:
Elasticsearch is a search and analytics engine that speaks plain HTTP for every operation, and this app exposes that directly: search with the full Query DSL, index, fetch, update and delete individual documents, and create, delete, list and inspect indices and their mappings.

Because an Elasticsearch cluster can live anywhere — a hosted deployment, a customer's own VPC, an on-prem box — this app connects to whichever cluster a workflow's credentials point at rather than a single fixed vendor host, so it works the same way against Elastic Cloud, a self-managed cluster, or another cloud provider's managed Elasticsearch.

Search passes a query straight through in Elasticsearch's own DSL, which means anything the engine can express — full-text search, filters, aggregations — is available rather than a narrowed subset. Document actions cover indexing with or without an explicit id, partial updates that merge into an existing document, and deletion; index actions cover creation with optional mappings and settings, deletion, listing and reading a mapping back.
